name: Nahum
overview: The book of Nahum, a minor prophetic work, reveals God's sovereign majesty and His righteous judgment against the Assyrians, particularly the city of Nineveh. The opening verses emphasize God's jealousy and vengeance, portraying Him as slow to anger yet powerful and just in punishing the wicked. Through vivid imagery of natural forces subdued by His command, Nahum declares that none can withstand God's fierce indignation, affirming His care for His people by ensuring the downfall of their oppressors.
